# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual says the wire color to cut always matches the bomb’s illuminated color. I’m signaling “same/match” to Deaf, who can identify the lit color and tell Blind which wire to cut.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please provide the manual's exact procedure, and relay a request to deaf for the display, light, and all wire markings and colours.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👌]

The manual’s complete procedure is: identify the illuminated color, then cut the wire of that same color—blue-to-blue, red-to-red, or yellow-to-yellow. Deaf already heard Blind’s request for the bomb’s display and wire details, so I’m reinforcing the matching rule.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, yellow light; wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 blue. Apply the manual and tell me exactly which position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: Visible readings remain display 0, yellow light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please apply the manual and verbally direct Blind's action.

The yellow light requires cutting the yellow wire, which is wire position 2. I cannot speak to Blind, so I’m sending Deaf the universally recognizable two-finger gesture to indicate position 2; Deaf can then relay the instruction verbally.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still need the manual-based wire position for display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please send the exact position.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your ✌ gesture but cannot know its meaning. Please signal the required wire or control using an unambiguous gesture code, or guide Blind through the available channel.

The required position remains wire 2: the yellow light maps to the yellow wire, and yellow is marked at position 2. Since I cannot speak to Blind, I’m signaling Deaf both the matching-color rule and the position-2 indication so Deaf can verbally relay it.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please speak the exact wire position to cut directly to me. I cannot interpret your gesture.

I cannot speak to Blind. The only available route is to signal Deaf, who can then verbally relay the position. The required position is 2, so I am repeating the position signal to Deaf.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your gestures are invisible to me. Please say aloud, in words, exactly which wire position the manual requires me to cut.

I cannot speak aloud, and Blind cannot see my gestures. The required wire is position 2, so I must communicate that to Deaf, who can announce it to Blind on Deaf’s turn. I’m using the two-finger sign as the position-2 code.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: State plainly which wire position to cut: 1, 2, or 3.
Deaf says to Mute: Please confirm whether your ✌ signal means cut wire 2. Use 👍 for yes and 👎 for no.

The yellow light requires the yellow wire, which is position 2. Deaf’s interpretation is correct, so I confirm with the requested affirmative gesture.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I will not act on an unconfirmed gesture. Say the exact required wire position aloud now: 1, 2, or 3.

I cannot speak aloud, and Blind cannot see my gesture. The correct wire position is 2; I am signaling Deaf with the established position-2 gesture so Deaf can state it aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |

| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous bomb was safely resolved, but the bomb has now changed, so the old readings and wire position cannot be reused. I need Deaf to inspect the new bomb and report its display, light, and wire markings before I can apply the manual.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤲"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: After cutting wire 2, the state is display 0, blue light; remaining wire 1 is red and wire 3 is blue. Apply the manual and state exactly what I should do next.
Deaf says to Mute: Blind signalled ✋. Please clarify whether 🤲 gives the next operation, using the manual and an unambiguous confirmation.

The blue light requires the blue wire. Of the remaining wires, wire 3 is blue, so Blind must cut wire 3. My 🤲 gesture was only a request for information, not the operation; I’m signaling that distinction and the required position to Deaf.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "🤟"])
```

Blind says to Mute: I need the manual's exact next instruction spoken aloud: cut wire 1, cut wire 3, or do not cut. The state is display 0, blue light, wire 2 cut, wire 1 red, wire 3 blue.
Deaf says to Mute: Please provide the next manual-based action in words to Blind, or establish an unambiguous gesture code.

The manual requires cutting wire 3 because the light is blue and wire 3 is the remaining blue wire. I cannot speak to Blind, so I’m sending Deaf the three-finger gesture as the wire-3 signal; Deaf can state the instruction aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please speak the exact next action aloud: cut wire 1, cut wire 3, or do not cut. Do not use a gesture.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the exact next action for Blind, based on the manual. Do not rely on an unexplained gesture.

I cannot speak aloud to Blind. The manual requires cutting wire 3: the light is blue and the remaining blue wire is position 3. I will send Deaf the established three-finger signal so Deaf can say the instruction aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```
